tools.name: screen_entity
tools.description: Screen a person or company name against 13 sanctions and export-control lists: OFAC SDN, OFAC Non-SDN, EU Financial Sanctions, UN Security Council, UK Sanctions List, Canada SEMA, Swiss SECO, BIS Denied Persons, BIS Entity List, BIS Unverified List, BIS Military End-User, ITAR Debarred and State Non

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "screen_entity" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Screen a person or company name against 8 sanctions lists: OFAC SDN, OFAC Non-SDN (Consolidated), BIS Denied Persons List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Financial Sanctions File, UK OFSI Consolidated List, Canada SEMA, and Swiss SECO. Fuzzy name matching, so transliterations and spelling" → after: "Screen a person or company name against 13 sanctions and export-control lists: OFAC SDN, OFAC Non-SDN, EU Financial Sanctions, UN Security Council, UK Sanctions List, Canada SEMA, Swiss SECO, BIS Denied Persons, BIS Entity List, BIS Unverified List, BIS Military End-User, ITAR Debarred and State Non"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
